Author: Tataru-business
Name: Keybound Automation
Description: Reads Keybound Brawler prompts and answers with keyboard input. Open /tatarubrawler, set the number of runs, and press Start auto queue from the Keybound lobby or duty.
Punchline: Automatically type Keybound Brawler prompts and optionally keep queueing.
Changelog: - Set a run count and press Start auto queue. Stop after current game finishes the active or queued game without starting another.
